interpretation: C7 upper-to-R5 upper = 4 ohm; C6 upper-to-R5 lower = 3.3 ohm. Together with U2-C7 = 1.5 ohm, C7-C6 = 27 ohm, U2-C6 = 24 ohm and R5 marking220 (22 ohm), the evidence strongly supports R5 feeding U2/C7 from H_RF_VDD. A few ohms may include contact contributions; exact copper resistance was not measured. No extra resistor is invented. Old R5 output/antenna placement is withdrawn as an incorrect inference.
